  - Minutes from KIET Group of Institutions (popular student culinary hub).
  - Easily reachable from Modinagar, Duhai, Muradnagar RRTS station, and Raj Nagar Extension.

## 3. Ambience & Guest Amenities
- **Atmosphere**: Cozy, romantic warm-amber lighting, bistro seating, floral and botanical decor accents, gentle background acoustic music.
- **Connectivity**: High-speed complimentary Wi-Fi for students, professionals, and digital nomads.
- **Dining Technology**: Contactless Table QR Code ordering. Diners scan the QR code at their table to view the real-time menu, customize items, submit the ticket straight to the kitchen display, and pay via UPI or card.
- **Events & Celebrations**: Custom birthday celebrations, anniversary surprises, candlelight couple dinners, and college team gatherings.

---

## 4. Dietary Standards & Food Safety
- **100% Pure Vegetarian (Shuddh Shakahari)**: No eggs, no meat, no poultry, no seafood used in any recipe or stored on the premises.
- **Dairy Quality**: Fresh dairy milk, real cheese (mozzarella, cheddar blends), and fresh cottage cheese (paneer).
- **Customizable**: Jain preparations (without onion/garlic) and customized spice levels available on order.

---

## 5. Comprehensive Food & Drink Menu (with Prices in INR)

### Artisanal Pasta
- **Penne Arabiata (₹139)**: Penne pasta tossed in spicy Italian tomato concassé with garlic, oregano, and sautéed farm vegetables.
- **White Sauce Pasta / Penne Alfredo (₹149)**: Penne coated in velvety Alfredo cream, melted cheese, black pepper, and garden veggies.
- **Creamy Makhani Sauce Pasta (₹159)**: Rich fusion pasta combining aromatic Indian butter makhani gravy with Italian penne.
- **Penne Rosa Love Pasta (₹159)**: Signature pink sauce pasta uniting San Marzano tomatoes with heavy dairy cream and fragrant herbs.

### Handcrafted Burgers
- **Aloo Tikki Burger (₹79)**: Crispy spiced potato patty, sliced tomato, crisp onion, and tangy herb mayo.
- **Double Cheese Vegetable Burger (₹99)**: Premium vegetable patty topped with double melted cheese slices, crunchy lettuce, and jalapenos.
- **Cottage Cheese Burger (₹109)**: Thick paneer slab seasoned with herbs, grilled, and layered with smoky BBQ sauce.
- **Double Tikki Cheese Burger (₹129)**: Two crispy patties stacked with double cheese and house signature sauce.

### Crispy Grilled Sandwiches
- **Veg Club Sandwich (₹79)**: Layered sandwich with fresh shredded greens, cucumber, tomato, and seasoned mayonnaise.
- **Peri Peri Paneer & Corn Sandwich (₹99)**: Spiced peri peri paneer tossed with sweet golden corn and garlic mayo.
- **Corn & Spinach Grilled Cheese Sandwich (₹109)**: Melted cheese combined with sweet corn kernels and tender sautéed spinach.
- **Bombay Grilled Sandwich (₹119)**: Mumbai street-style potato bhaji, spiced chaat seasoning, mint-coriander chutney, and cheese.

### Indo-Chinese & Noodles
- **Veg Hakka Noodles (₹99)**: Wok-tossed long wheat noodles with crunchy cabbage, bell peppers, carrots, and spring onions.
- **Chilli Garlic Noodles (₹109)**: Fiery noodles tossed in wok-roasted garlic and red chilli paste.
- **Schezwan Noodles (₹119)**: Spicy Schezwan infused noodles with wok-tossed greens.
- **Paneer Noodles (₹129)**: Savory noodles loaded with paneer cubes and crunchy vegetables.
- **Veg Fried Rice (₹99)**: Aromatic basmati rice stir-fried with finely diced garden vegetables and light soy.
- **Paneer Fried Rice (₹119)**: Fragrant rice tossed with golden paneer bites and spring onions.
- **Schezwan Fried Rice (₹119)**: Fiery spiced wok rice with Schezwan peppers.

### Dumpling Creations (Momos)
- **Steamed Veg Momo (₹69)** / **Fried Veg Momo (₹79)**
- **Steamed Paneer Momo (₹89)** / **Fried Paneer Momo (₹99)**
- **Kurkure Veg Momo (₹99)** / **Kurkure Paneer Momo (₹119)**: Ultra-crunchy crumb-coated outer crust with savory steaming core.
- **Cheese Corn Steamed Momo (₹99)** / **Cheese Corn Fried Momo (₹109)**

### Stone-Baked Pizzas (Thin & Hand-Tossed)
- **Simple Veg Pizza (₹129)**: Onion, capsicum, and melted mozzarella.
- **Margherita Pizza (₹139)**: Rich tomato herb sauce, extra mozzarella cheese, and fragrant basil.
- **The Hero Pizza (₹159)**: Signature pizza loaded with capsicum, red paprika, corn, and double mozzarella.
- **Paneer Tikka Pizza (₹169)**: Smoky tandoori spiced paneer cubes, crisp capsicum, and roasted onion slivers.

### Sizzling Snacks & Starters
- **Salted French Fries (₹69)** / **Peri Peri French Fries (₹79)** / **Cheese Loaded French Fries (₹99)**
- **Chilli Potato (₹89)** / **Honey Chilli Potato (₹99)**: Crispy potato fingers glazed in sticky honey-chilli sauce and toasted sesame.
- **Chilli Paneer Dry / Gravy (₹139)**: Crispy cottage cheese cubes tossed with capsicum, onion, and dark soy sauce.
- **Crispy Corn (₹89)**: Fried sweet corn kernels tossed with black salt, lemon, and chaat spices.
- **Veg Spring Rolls (₹89)**: Golden crispy pastry rolls stuffed with shredded wok vegetables.

### Comfort Maggies
- **Classic Masala Maggie (₹49)**
- **Vegetable Masala Maggie (₹59)**
- **Cheese Butter Maggie (₹69)**
- **Peri Peri Veggie Maggie (₹69)**

### Waffles, Desserts & Thick Shakes
- **Belgian Chocolate Waffle (₹99)**: Freshly pressed crispy waffle drizzled with melted dark & milk chocolate.
- **KitKat Shake (₹99)**: Creamy vanilla ice cream blended with crushed KitKat wafers and chocolate syrup.
- **Oreo Shake (₹99)**: Rich blended milkshake with crushed Oreo cookies.
- **Cold Coffee with Ice Cream (₹89)**: Chilled espresso shaken with thick milk and topped with vanilla ice cream.
